metadata.name: Navo
metadata.description: Independent, unofficial Telegram client for Android, Windows, and macOS. Sign in with your existing Telegram account — built with Flutter on TDLib.

summary.zh: Navo是基于Flutter与TDLib开发的独立非官方Telegram跨平台客户端，支持Android、iOS、Windows、macOS四大主流平台，用户可使用现有Telegram账号登录，实现多端消息同步，提供接近原生的即时通讯使用体验。
summary.en: Navo is an independent unofficial Telegram cross-platform client built with Flutter and TDLib, supporting Android, iOS, Windows and macOS. Users can log in with their existing Telegram accounts to sync messages across devices, delivering a near-native instant messaging experience.

metadata.name: EcoHub
metadata.description: 一款高性能、现代化支持的全栈多源影视采集聚合系统，用于搭建自己的私人影视库，支持Tvbox与Ecohub原生应用

summary.zh: EcoHub是基于Go与Next.js开发的高性能全栈多源影视聚合自托管系统，支持多源采集自动化管理，可快速搭建私人影视库，兼容TVBox、鸿蒙及安卓客户端，提供Docker一键部署与可视化管理后台，适用于影视爱好者自建私有观影平台场景。
summary.en: EcoHub is a high-performance full-stack multi-source video aggregation self-hosted system built with Go and Next.js. It supports automated multi-source collection and management, enabling users to quickly build private video libraries. It is compatible with TVBox, HarmonyOS and Android clients, offers one-click Docker deployment and a visual management backend, and is suitable for video enthusiasts to build private viewing platforms.

metadata.name: edgeever
metadata.description: Open-source, AI-native knowledge base & Evernote alternative with native MCP. Zero-cost on Cloudflare or Docker.

summary.zh: EdgeEver是开源AI原生知识库与Evernote替代方案，原生支持MCP协议，可在Cloudflare免费额度或Docker环境下零成本部署，保留经典三栏笔记布局，全栈开源支持自托管，集成AI Agent，轻量流畅适配多端知识管理与高效记录场景。
summary.en: EdgeEver is an open-source, AI-native knowledge base and Evernote alternative with native MCP support. It enables zero-cost deployment on Cloudflare's free tier or via Docker, retains the classic three-pane note layout, features a fully open-source stack for self-hosting, integrates AI Agents, and delivers a lightweight, smooth experience for cross-device knowledge management and efficient note-taking.

metadata.name: Open-Box
metadata.description: OpenWrt 一体化透明代理方案:一条命令装完 sing-box 内核 + 管理面板,浏览器打开即用

summary.:: Open-Box是面向OpenWrt及Debian/Ubuntu系统的一体化透明代理方案，一条命令即可完成sing-box内核、管理面板及地理数据的一键部署，无需手写配置文件，通过Web界面即可完成订阅管理、流量分流、DNS配置等操作，支持多协议代理、链式代理、规则集导入等特性，适配主/旁路由及主机使用场景。
summary.en: Open-Box is an all-in-one transparent proxy solution for OpenWrt and Debian/Ubuntu systems. It enables one-click deployment of sing-box kernel, management panel and geolocation data without manual configuration. Users can complete subscription management, traffic routing and DNS settings via web interface, with support for multi-protocol proxy, chained proxy and rule set import, applicable to primary/side routers and host usage scenarios.

metadata.name: LetRecovery
metadata.description: 一款免费开源的 Windows 系统重装工具

summary.:: 免费开源的Windows系统重装工具，基于Rust开发，支持WIM/ESD/GHO等多格式镜像部署、BitLocker加密盘重装、系统备份恢复、在线镜像下载及驱动/分区管理，兼容UEFI/Legacy启动模式，提供桌面端与WinPE双端部署能力，适配Windows 7至11系统维护场景。
summary.en: LetRecovery is a free and open-source Windows system reinstallation tool built with Rust. It supports deployment of multi-format system images (WIM/ESD/GHO etc.), BitLocker-encrypted disk reinstallation, system backup & recovery, online image download, and driver/partition management. Compatible with UEFI/Legacy boot modes, it provides both desktop and WinPE deployment scenarios for Windows 7-11 system maintenance.

metadata.name: HeinPlay
metadata.description: 海因影视，用于lunatv（moontv）的Android TV客户端，以及手机、Windows等多平台客户端，本地缓存比网页版更流畅的访问速度

summary.zh: 基于Flutter开发的跨平台LunaTV（MoonTV）影视客户端，覆盖Android TV、手机、Windows、Linux（适配Steam Deck）等多端，鸿蒙NEXT版在研，优化本地缓存提升访问流畅度，支持直播时移、多服务器自动测速切换、IPv6优先，适配大屏遥控与触屏操作。
summary.en: A Flutter-based cross-platform LunaTV (MoonTV) video streaming client supporting Android TV, mobile, Windows, Linux (optimized for Steam Deck) and HarmonyOS NEXT (in development). It optimizes local caching for smoother access than web version, features live TV time-shift, automatic server speed test switching, IPv6 priority, multi-player backend support, and dual-account quick switching, with optimized remote control and touchscreen interactions.

metadata.name: zhangxuefeng-skill
metadata.description: 张雪峰.skill — 张雪峰的认知操作系统。高考志愿/考研/职业规划的实战思维框架。由女娲.skill生成。

summary.zh: 本仓库为张雪峰认知操作系统的AI Skill，基于其著作、权威采访及一手内容深度调研，蒸馏出核心心智模型与决策启发式，可模拟张雪峰风格输出高考志愿、考研、职业规划的实战决策建议，是可落地的思维框架而非语录合集，适配多AI运行时。
summary.en: This repo is an AI Skill for Zhang Xuefeng's cognitive operating system, distilled from his published works, authoritative interviews and original content, extracting core mental models and decision heuristics. It can simulate Zhang Xuefeng's speaking style to provide practical decision suggestions for college entrance examination application, postgraduate exam and career planning, serving as a runnable thinking framework rather than a simple quote collection, and supports multiple AI runtimes.

metadata.name: czkawka
metadata.description: Multi functional app to find duplicates, empty folders, similar images etc.

summary.zh: Rust开发的内存安全跨平台文件清理工具套件，核心库可复用，配套Krokiet（Slint桌面GUI）、CLI、Android端Cedinia多前端，支持重复/相似/损坏文件检测、空文件夹清理、EXIF移除等全场景文件整理功能，无广告无数据收集，多线程运行高效快速。

metadata.name: stremio-web
metadata.description: Stremio - Freedom to Stream

summary.:: Stremio Web是开源流媒体中心Stremio的官方Web端，基于React开发，核心逻辑由Rust编译为WebAssembly运行在Web Worker中。支持插件化内容发现、跨设备同步、投屏、多语言字幕，可安装为PWA，为用户提供一站式视频流媒体娱乐服务。
summary.en: Stremio Web is the official web client of the open-source media center Stremio, built with React and powered by a Rust engine compiled to WebAssembly running in a Web Worker. It supports addon-powered content discovery, cross-device sync, casting, multi-language subtitles, and PWA installation, delivering an all-in-one video streaming entertainment solution.

metadata.name: gitpush
metadata.description: an AI Github Rlease Tracker Powered by Cloudflare

metadata.name: clash-verge-rev
metadata.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience

summary.zh: Clash Verge官方继任项目，是基于Tauri 2与Rust开发的跨平台Clash Meta图形化客户端，支持Windows、macOS、Linux三大桌面系统，内置代理内核，提供可视化节点管理、TUN模式、配置同步等能力，大幅降低代理工具使用门槛。
summary.en: As the official successor to Clash Verge, this is a cross-platform GUI client for Clash Meta built with Tauri 2 and Rust. It supports Windows, macOS and Linux, integrates a built-in proxy core, and offers features like visual node management, TUN mode and configuration sync, greatly lowering the usage threshold of proxy tools.

metadata.name: JAVBUS
metadata.description: 一个插件式BT种子搜索器，通过为BHT爬虫网站、BT资源收集网站制作html正则匹配json插件，来实现一个软件-全网资源的效果。同时支持网盘搜索、局域网互传

summary.:: JAVBUS是基于Flutter开发的插件式资源聚合工具，核心采用声明式JSON插件协议实现BT磁力搜索，无需编程即可编写与分发插件，同时集成网盘搜索、链接收藏管理与局域网文件/文本互传功能，跨平台支持且移动端友好，大幅降低资源搜索工具的插件开发与使用门槛。
summary.en: JAVBUS is a Flutter-based pluginized resource aggregation tool that leverages a declarative JSON plugin protocol for BT magnet search, enabling users to create and distribute plugins without coding. It also integrates cloud drive search, link collection management and LAN file/text transfer, with cross-platform support and mobile-friendly design, greatly lowering the threshold for resource search tool development and usage.

metadata.name: x-ui-pro
metadata.description: XUI-PRO nginx reverse proxy with ws/grpc/httpupgrade/splithttp,xray protocol support: vless,vmess,trojan,shadowsocks panel cloudflare ssl,xtls,ssr,v2fly,v2ray installer bypass restrictions sing-box,shadowtls,reality,tunnel,gfw tor warp wireguard geoip tuic clash vpn mihomo psiphon hy2 oneclick argo bbr wstunnel anticensorship⚡🛡️

summary.zh: x-ui-pro是面向Linux服务器的开源反审查代理一键部署工具，整合x-ui、v2rayA、WARP、Psiphon、Tor等主流代理组件，基于nginx实现WebSocket、GRPC等多协议反向代理，支持Cloudflare CDN、自动SSL续期、假网站伪装、多域名管理，可快速搭建稳定的代理服务以规避网络限制。
summary.en: x-ui-pro is an open-source one-click deployment tool designed for anti-censorship proxy services on Linux servers. It integrates mainstream proxy components including x-ui, v2rayA, WARP, Psiphon and Tor, implements multi-protocol reverse proxy supporting WebSocket, GRPC, HttpUpgrade and XHTTP via nginx, supports Cloudflare CDN integration, automatic SSL renewal, fake website camouflage and multi-domain management, enabling users to quickly build stable proxy services to bypass internet restrictions.

metadata.name: lx-lxwalnut-music-mobile
metadata.description: 基于lx-netease-music-mobile改版，满足个人需求，仅个人自用！！！

summary.zh: 本仓库为个人定制的React Native跨平台移动端聚合音乐客户端，基于开源项目改版，整合网易云音乐、QQ音乐、酷狗音乐三大平台资源，支持自定义音源、多平台登录、云盘管理、听歌识曲、小爱协同、WebDAV备份及高度自定义主题，适配横竖屏场景，仅供个人自用。
summary.en: This repository is a personally customized cross-platform mobile aggregated music client built with React Native, modified from open-source projects. It integrates resources from NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music and KuGou Music, supporting custom audio sources, multi-platform login, cloud disk management, song recognition, Xiao AI collaboration, WebDAV backup and highly customizable themes, adapting to both portrait and landscape modes for personal use only.

metadata.name: lx-music-server
metadata.description: 运行在 Hono.js 上的 LX Music 数据同步服务，支持Cloudflare Worker部署

summary.zh: 本仓库是LX音乐数据同步服务的Cloudflare Workers重构版，基于Hono.js与Durable Objects实现，无需自托管服务器即可支持多设备实时同步歌单、 dislikes规则，具备多用户隔离、快照冲突处理能力，可通过GitHub Actions一键部署。
summary.en: This repository is a Cloudflare Workers rewrite of the LX Music data sync service, built with Hono.js and Durable Objects. It enables real-time multi-device sync for playlists and dislike rules without self-hosted servers, featuring user isolation, snapshot conflict resolution, and one-click deployment via GitHub Actions.

metadata.name: LinkSwift
metadata.description: 一个基于 JavaScript 的网盘文件下载地址获取工具。基于【网盘直链下载助手】修改 ，支持 百度网盘 / 阿里云盘 / 中国移动云盘 / 天翼云盘 / 迅雷云盘 / 夸克网盘 / UC网盘 / 123云盘 八大网盘

summary.zh: LinkSwift是基于JavaScript开发的网盘直链获取用户脚本，支持百度网盘、阿里云盘等8大主流网盘，可绕过客户端限制提取文件直链，搭配会员增强脚本可优化下载体验，适用于资源下载、文件批量导出等场景。
summary.en: LinkSwift is a JavaScript-based user script for extracting direct download links from cloud storage platforms. It supports 8 mainstream services including Baidu Netdisk, Alibaba Cloud Disk and China Mobile Cloud Disk, bypassing client restrictions to obtain direct file links. When paired with membership enhancement scripts, it delivers better download experience for scenarios like resource acquisition and batch file export.

metadata.name: ai-coding-welfare
metadata.description: AI Coding 福利站导航：免费白嫖 Claude Code / Codex 的中转站与公益站合集，含额度、模型、价格自动更新与一键配置脚本

summary.:: 本仓库为AI编程工具福利站导航，聚合Claude Code、Codex等工具的免费/低价中转与公益站，自动更新站点额度、模型、价格信息，提供一键配置脚本、站点横评与可用性历史追踪，支持社区投稿补充站点资源。
summary.en: This repository is a navigation hub for AI coding tool welfare sites, aggregating free and low-cost relay as well as public welfare platforms for tools like Claude Code and Codex. It automatically updates site quotas, supported models and pricing information, provides one-click configuration scripts, cross-site comparison and availability history tracking, and supports community submissions to supplement site resources.

metadata.name: MyIP
metadata.description: The best IP Toolbox. Check your IP address & geolocation, test IP for WebRTC and DNS IP leaks, run an IP quality check, browser fingerprint check, website availability check, network speed test, global latency test, MTR test, Whois search, and more.

summary.zh: 开源可自托管的全能IP工具箱，集成IP多源查询、WebRTC/DNS泄露检测、网络测速、MTR路由、全球连通性检查、浏览器指纹等20余项功能，支持Docker一键部署与PWA，适用于个人隐私自查、网络连通性测试、代理/VPN有效性验证等场景，功能全面且可完全本地化运行。
summary.en: An open-source, self-hostable all-in-one IP toolbox integrating over 20 features including multi-source IP lookup, WebRTC/DNS leak detection, speed test, MTR routing, global connectivity check, and browser fingerprinting. It supports one-click Docker deployment and PWA, suitable for personal privacy self-check, network connectivity testing, and proxy/VPN effectiveness verification, with fully localizable operation.

metadata.name: lx-music-xinghai-source
metadata.description: 星海音乐源 | LX Music 自定义音源插件，聚合 GDAPI/ChKSz API，支持酷我加密音频解密（需自行配置）

summary.zh: 星海音乐源是LX Music自定义音源插件，聚合GDAPI、ChKSz等公开接口，支持网易云、QQ、酷我、酷狗、咪咕五大平台多音质音乐获取，可配合自建中转服务器解密酷我加密音频，仅供个人学习交流使用。
summary.en: Xinghai Music Source is a custom audio source plugin for LX Music, aggregating public APIs like GDAPI and ChKSz to support multi-bitrate music acquisition from 5 major platforms including NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music, Kuwo Music, Kugou Music and Migu Music. It can decrypt Kuwo's encrypted audio via a self-deployed relay server, for personal learning and communication only.

metadata.name: xiaozhi-esp32
metadata.description: An MCP-based chatbot | 一个基于MCP的聊天机器人

summary.zh: 小智是基于MCP协议的ESP32端侧AI智能体，对接通义千问、DeepSeek等大模型，支持离线语音唤醒、全双工语音交互、设备端与云端MCP能力扩展，适配多款ESP32开发板，可快速搭建具备语音交互、设备控制能力的智能硬件终端。
summary.en: XiaoZhi is an ESP32-based edge AI Agent leveraging the MCP protocol, integrated with large models such as Qwen and DeepSeek. It supports offline voice wake-up, full-duplex voice interaction, device-side and cloud-side MCP capability expansion, and is compatible with multiple ESP32 development boards, enabling rapid development of intelligent hardware terminals with voice interaction and device control functions.

metadata.name: Median
metadata.description: 一个功能密度极高的，安装包仅200kb的极致轻量化浏览器

summary.zh: Median是极致轻量化的本地优先Android浏览器，安装包仅200kb，基于系统WebView用原生Java开发，无广告/遥测SDK，集成广告拦截、本地加密密码库、用户脚本、离线阅读等功能，所有数据默认本地存储，主打隐私安全与轻量浏览体验。
summary.en: Median is an extremely lightweight local-first Android browser with a mere 200KB installer. Built natively in Java on top of Android System WebView, it has no ad or telemetry SDKs, and provides features like ad blocking, local encrypted password vault, userscript support, and offline reading, with all user data stored locally by default for privacy-focused browsing.

metadata.name: openwrt-clashoo
metadata.description: 基于 mihomo 和 sing-box 的简单、稳定、开箱即用的 LuCI 代理应用

summary.zh: 面向OpenWrt路由器的LuCI双内核代理管理插件，集成mihomo与sing-box双内核，支持一键订阅拉取、DNS策略配置、透明代理设置，提供可视化运行面板与配置自动校验，主打简单稳定、开箱即用，适用于路由器的网络代理与流量分流场景。
暂无描述。

metadata.name: FluxDown
metadata.description: Rust 驱动的多协议下载管理器，支持 HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent 磁力链接及 HLS/DASH 流媒体，智能多线程加速与浏览器无缝集成。精美界面，极致性能，永久免费，零广告。

summary.zh: FluxDown是基于Rust开发的开源多协议下载管理器，支持HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent、HLS/DASH等主流协议，具备智能多线程加速、浏览器集成、MCP服务能力，覆盖桌面/移动/NAS等多平台，永久免费无广告，是IDM的高性能替代方案。
summary.en: FluxDown is a Rust-based open-source multi-protocol download manager supporting HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent, HLS/DASH and other mainstream protocols. It features smart multi-threaded acceleration, browser integration, built-in MCP server, cross-platform support for desktop, mobile and NAS, and is completely free and ad-free, serving as a high-performance alternative to IDM.

metadata.name: hsck
metadata.description: hsck json

summary.zh: 海阔小程序离线视频数据采集工具，基于Python开发，可自动采集视频数据并生成JSON/TXT/M3U等多格式离线源文件，支持媒体缓存避免重复下载、滑块验证反爬处理与微信推送通知，支持本地运行及GitHub Actions定时更新，适用于视频源聚合分发场景。
summary.en: A Python-based offline video data collection tool for Haikuo mini-programs, which automatically collects video data and generates multi-format offline source files including JSON, TXT and M3U. It supports media caching to avoid repeated downloads, sliding captcha anti-crawling handling and WeChat push notifications, and supports local operation and scheduled updates via GitHub Actions, applicable to video source aggregation and distribution scenarios.

metadata.name: fapiao-print
metadata.description: 发票酱 - 发票批量打印工具，轻量桌面应用+WEB模式，支持 PDF、OFD、XML、图片等多格式，一键识别发票数据，快速排版、打印、重命名或导出

metadata.name: CoShell
metadata.description: 一款集成 AI 助手的轻量级 SSH 终端桌面应用。

summary.zh: CoShell是一款本地优先的轻量级Windows桌面SSH/SFTP工作台，集成AI运维助手与内置搜索，支持远程终端、文件管理、在线编辑及全链路加密存储，无需依赖外部服务，适合个人及可信网络环境下的服务器运维场景。
summary.en: CoShell is a local-first lightweight Windows desktop SSH/SFTP workstation integrating an AI ops assistant and built-in search. It supports remote terminal, file management, online editing, and full-chain encrypted storage without external service dependencies, suitable for server operations in personal and trusted network environments.

metadata.name: cf-manager
metadata.description: An all-in-one multi-account dashboard for Cloudflare. Manage Workers, DNS, KV/D1/R2 storage, AI inference & browser rendering visually, with an OpenAI-compatible API for external integration.

summary.zh: CF Manager 是面向 Cloudflare 用户的自托管多账号统一运维面板，可视化管理 DNS、Workers、KV/D1/R2 存储、AI 推理及浏览器渲染能力，提供本地 OpenAI 兼容接口，解决多账号切换、批量资源操作痛点，支持凭证加密与配额监控。
summary.en: CF Manager is a self-hosted multi-account unified operations panel for Cloudflare users, enabling visual management of DNS, Workers, KV/D1/R2 storage, AI inference and browser rendering. It offers a local OpenAI-compatible interface, solves pain points of multi-account switching and bulk resource operations, and supports encrypted credentials and quota monitoring.

metadata.name: C-SSH
metadata.description: Native cross-platform SSH ops: Windows/Android stable + macOS v0.8.8 test build. 原生跨平台 SSH 运维 · Windows/Android 正式版 + macOS 测试版

summary.zh: C-SSH是原生跨平台服务器运维工具，支持Windows/Android正式版与macOS测试版，集成SSH终端、RDP远程桌面、资源监控、文件管理及本地AI助手，支持自动部署Windows Agent、多线路代理与端到端加密同步，覆盖多系统服务器运维核心场景与需求。
summary.en: C-SSH is a native cross-platform server operations tool with official Windows/Android releases and a macOS test build. It integrates SSH terminal, RDP remote desktop, resource monitoring, file management and local AI assistant, supporting automatic Windows Agent deployment, multi-line proxy and end-to-end encrypted sync for cross-system server operations.

metadata.name: otter-music
metadata.description: 基于 React + Capacitor 的免费音乐 App，支持多音源搜索、网易云登录、主流平台歌单导入，以及 B 站音源搜索播放，安装包仅 2.5 MB。基于 GD Studio's Online Music Platform API。

summary.value: 水獭音乐是基于React+Capacitor开发的免费多音源聚合音乐播放器，支持多平台音源搜索、主流平台歌单导入、B站音源播放，具备多源回退、智能音源匹配、数据备份等功能，支持PWA与安卓端安装，安装包仅2.5MB，适配多端音乐收听场景。

metadata.name: uart_sms_forwarder
metadata.description: Air780 短信UART转发器

summary.:: 本项目是基于合宙Air780系列4G模块的短信UART转发系统，通过UART串口实现4G模块与上位机的短信交互，支持短信收发、来电告警及钉钉、企业微信等多平台通知推送，提供Web管理界面与Docker/原生部署方案，适用于物联网设备短信监控、运维告警等场景。
summary.en: This project is a UART SMS forwarding system built for LuatOS Air780 series 4G modules, which realizes SMS interaction between the 4G module and host computer via UART. It supports SMS sending/receiving, incoming call alerts, and multi-platform (DingTalk, WeCom, Feishu etc.) notification push, with a web management interface and Docker/native deployment options, suitable for IoT device SMS monitoring and operation alert scenarios.

summary.zh: 基于LuatOS开发的Air780E 4G物联网模块短信智能转发系统，支持关键词与正则匹配，可将短信异步转发至企业微信、飞书、钉钉、邮件等多渠道，具备网络容错、低功耗特性，适用于验证码统一接收、业务短信监控等场景。

metadata.name: renewhelper
metadata.description: RenewHelper - 时序·守望是一款基于Cloudflare Workers的全栈服务生命周期提醒、管理工具。它专为管理周期性订阅、域名续费、服务器到期等场景设计。无需服务器，零成本托管，提供精美的机甲风（Mecha-style）UI 界面、强大的农历/公历计算核心、多渠道通知推送能力、iCal日程同步以及账单管理功能。同时支持Worker和Docker方式部署。

summary.zh: RenewHelper是基于Cloudflare Workers开发的全栈服务生命周期管理工具，无需服务器、零成本托管，专为订阅续费、域名/服务器到期提醒等场景设计，支持农历周期计算、多渠道通知、账单管理与iCal同步，提供机甲风UI，支持Worker与Docker双部署。

metadata.name: trackerslist
metadata.description: Updated list of public BitTorrent trackers

summary.zh: 该仓库提供每日自动更新的公开BitTorrent tracker列表，覆盖UDP、HTTP、HTTPS、WebSocket、I2P等多协议类型，同时提供域名与IP双版本，已做去重与黑名单过滤，可有效解决BT下载时tracker连接问题，提升下载效率。
summary.en: This repository provides daily auto-updated public BitTorrent tracker lists, covering multiple protocols such as UDP, HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket and I2P, with both domain and IP versions available. Duplicate and blacklisted trackers are filtered out, effectively solving BT download tracker connection issues and improving download efficiency.

metadata.name: dysync.net
metadata.description: 视频同步工具

summary.zh: dysync.net（抖小云）是基于.NET Core与Vue开发的抖音内容同步工具，支持同步抖音收藏夹、「我喜欢」及指定博主作品，内置视频信息刮削能力，同步后的视频可直接接入Emby、Jellyfin等媒体服务器播放，支持多账号同步与Docker部署，解决抖音收藏视频无法在家庭媒体中心统一管理的痛点。

metadata.name: bilibili-video-downloader
metadata.description: 哔哩哔哩 bilibili B站 视频 下载器，图形界面 + nfo刮削 + 广告标记 + 字幕下载 + 弹幕下载，轻松将视频加入emby等媒体库

summary.zh: 基于Tauri v2开发的跨平台B站视频下载工具，支持普通视频、番剧、课程、充电视频等全类型内容下载，提供图形界面，具备NFO刮削、字幕/弹幕下载、广告章节标记、自定义命名等功能，可无缝对接Emby等媒体库。
summary.en: A cross-platform Bilibili video downloader built with Tauri v2, supporting all content types such as regular videos, anime, courses and paid videos. It features a GUI, NFO scraping, subtitle/danmaku download, ad chapter marking and custom naming, enabling seamless integration with media servers like Emby.

summary.:: CFnew是基于Cloudflare Workers/Pages的边缘代理订阅管理服务，支持VLESS、Trojan等多协议，提供无外部依赖的订阅转换、优选IP动态管理、多客户端配置生成，通过KV存储实现配置即时生效，无需自建服务器，可灵活配置出站代理、自定义路径与DNS/ECH，适用于代理节点的订阅分发与运维管理场景。
summary.en: CFnew is an edge proxy subscription management service built on Cloudflare Workers/Pages, supporting multi-protocols like VLESS and Trojan. It provides dependency-free subscription conversion, dynamic optimal IP management, and multi-client config generation, with KV storage for instant config updates without self-built servers. It supports flexible outbound proxy, custom paths, DNS/ECH configuration, suitable for proxy node subscription distribution and O&M.

metadata.name: argosbx
metadata.description: 小白自建代理神器！ArgoSBX一键无交互小钢炮脚本💣：Sing-box、Xray、Argo三内核自动搭配；支持VPS、Docker、容器多环境部署；套CDN的5大方案+套WARP的15种组合；已支持协议：Naiveproxy、AnyTLS、Any-reality、Vless-xhttp-reality-vision-enc、Vless-tcp-reality-vision、Vless-xhttp-vision-enc、Vless-ws-vision-enc、Shadowsocks-2022、Hysteria2、Tuic、Socks5、Vmess-ws、Argo临时/固定隧道

summary.zh: Argosbx是面向小白的一键无交互代理部署工具，整合Sing-box、Xray、Argo三内核，支持VPS、Docker等多环境部署，内置15种WARP出站组合与5套CDN优选方案，覆盖Naiveproxy、Hysteria2等12+主流代理协议，无需域名即可快速搭建，解决IP被封、流媒体解锁痛点。
summary.en: Argosbx is a one-click non-interactive proxy deployment tool designed for beginners, integrating Sing-box, Xray and Argo kernels. It supports deployment on VPS, Docker and other environments, with 15 WARP outbound combinations and 5 CDN optimization schemes built-in. It covers 12+ mainstream proxy protocols including Naiveproxy and Hysteria2, enabling quick setup without domain names to solve pain points like IP blocking and streaming unlocking.

metadata.name: whistle
metadata.description: HTTP, HTTP2, HTTPS, Websocket debugging proxy

summary.zh: Whistle是基于Node.js的跨平台网络抓包调试代理工具，支持HTTP、HTTPS、HTTP/2、WebSocket、TCP等协议的抓包与请求/响应修改，内置Weinre、Composer等调试工具，支持规则配置与插件扩展，适用于前后端接口调试、网络问题排查等场景。
summary.en: Whistle is a Node.js-based cross-platform network packet capture and debugging proxy that supports capturing and modifying requests and responses for protocols including HTTP, HTTPS, HTTP/2, WebSocket and TCP. It provides built-in debugging tools like Weinre and Composer, supports rule-based configuration and plugin extension, and is suitable for front-end/back-end API debugging and network issue troubleshooting.

metadata.name: TVAPP
metadata.description: 收集全网 Android TV电视盒子应用，涵盖影视、直播、K歌、工具、游戏等类型，整理优质APK资源，支持便捷下载与自动更新。提供安全验证、分类索引与兼容性标注，助力用户打造家庭影音娱乐中心！              ✅ TVBox/影视仓等影音壳接口配置源。

summary.zh: 本仓库专注收集全网优质Android TV/电视盒子应用，涵盖影视、直播、K歌、工具等多类APK资源，提供TVBox/影视仓等影音壳接口配置源，支持便捷下载、安全验证与兼容性标注，助力用户快速搭建家庭影音娱乐中心。
summary.en: This repository focuses on collecting high-quality Android TV and TV box applications from across the web, covering APK resources for videos, live streaming, karaoke, tools and more. It provides interface configuration sources for media shells such as TVBox and YingshiCang, supports easy download, security verification and compatibility labeling, helping users quickly build a home audio-visual entertainment center.

metadata.name: go-rename
metadata.description: go-rename 照片视频重命名工具 支持Windows/MacOS/Linux等各平台

summary.zh: 基于Golang开发的跨平台照片视频重命名工具，解决不同设备拍摄文件重名、整理混乱问题，支持按EXIF拍摄时间、文件创建/修改时间或MD5值重命名，自动处理同名冲突，兼容Windows/MacOS/Linux全平台及多架构。
summary.en: A cross-platform photo and video renaming tool developed with Golang, designed to resolve file name duplication and disorganization issues from media captured by different devices. It supports renaming via EXIF shooting time, file creation/modification time or MD5 value, automatically handles name conflicts, and works across Windows/MacOS/Linux and multiple architectures.

metadata.name: free-nodes
metadata.description: 免费节点订阅：Clash、V2RayN、Shadowrocket｜Base64 与 YAML 每 2 小时更新

summary.zh: 本项目聚合公开免费代理节点，提供适配Clash、V2RayN、Shadowrocket等主流客户端的Base64与YAML格式订阅链接，每2小时自动更新并统一节点命名，附各客户端导入指南，仅做格式整理不承诺节点可用性与安全性。
summary.en: This project aggregates publicly available free proxy nodes, offering Base64 and YAML subscription links compatible with mainstream clients like Clash, V2RayN and Shadowrocket. It updates automatically every 2 hours with unified node naming, provides import guides for different clients, and only does format integration without guaranteeing node availability or security.

metadata.name: BiliTools
metadata.description: 本项目已停止维护。

summary.zh: 本项目为哔哩哔哩第三方辅助工具，因收到平台委托律所发出的侵权及不正当竞争法律函件，综合法律风险、维护成本、精力投入等多方面因素考量，已正式停止维护，不再开展版本发布、功能更新、问题处理及社区互动。
summary.en: This project is a third-party utility for Bilibili. It has been officially discontinued after receiving a legal letter from a law firm commissioned by Bilibili, which accused the project of infringement and unfair competition. Considering legal risks, maintenance costs, energy investment and other factors, the project will no longer carry out version releases, feature updates, issue handling and community interaction.

metadata.name: GitHubDaily
metadata.description: 坚持分享 GitHub 上高质量、有趣实用的开源技术教程、开发者工具、编程网站、技术资讯。A list cool, interesting projects of GitHub.

summary.zh: GitHubDaily是创立于2015年的开源项目聚合分享平台，累计收录超10000个GitHub优质开源项目，涵盖AI工具、开发工具、技术教程等类别，通过多平台传播帮助开发者发现优质开源资源、阅读源码提升技术能力。
summary.en: GitHubDaily is an open-source project curation platform founded in 2015, having collected over 10,000 high-quality GitHub open-source projects covering AI tools, development tools, technical tutorials and more. It helps developers discover valuable open-source resources and improve programming skills via source code reading through multi-platform distribution.

metadata.name: free-proxy-list
metadata.description: 🚀 Free HTTP, SOCKS4, & SOCKS5 proxy list * Updated every 5 minutes * and rotating proxy API (100+ countries)

summary.zh: Proxifly免费代理列表项目每5分钟自动更新验证，提供HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS4/SOCKS5多协议代理，覆盖133个国家共2.6万+可用节点，支持JSON/TXT/CSV多格式下载与API调用，配套跨平台客户端，可用于网页爬虫、网络访问等场景。

metadata.name: pansou
metadata.description: PanSou是一款高性能的网盘资源搜索API服务，支持TG频道和插件搜索。系统设计以性能和可扩展性为核心，支持多频道多插件并发搜索、结果智能排序和网盘类型分类。docker集成前后端，一键启动，开箱即用。仅供学习研究，请勿以各种形式用于盈利目的。 https://t.me/s/webhtv

summary.zh: PanSou是一款高性能网盘资源搜索API服务，支持TG频道与自定义插件并发搜索，具备多维度智能排序、多网盘类型自动分类、二级缓存机制，Docker集成前后端一键开箱即用，配套完整插件开发体系与AI辅助开发支持，仅供学习研究。

metadata.name: ai-goofish-monitor
metadata.description: 基于 Playwright 和AI实现的闲鱼多任务实时/定时监控与智能分析系统，配备了功能完善的后台管理UI。帮助用户从闲鱼海量商品中，找到心仪产品。

summary.zh: 基于Playwright与AI实现的闲鱼多任务实时/定时监控系统，配套完整Web管理后台，支持自然语言创建任务、多维度商品筛选、多渠道即时通知与Cron定时调度，可智能分析商品匹配度，帮助用户从闲鱼海量商品中快速定位心仪产品，支持Docker一键部署。
summary.en: An AI-powered Xianyu (Idle Fish) multi-task real-time and scheduled monitoring system built on Playwright, equipped with a full-featured web management backend. It supports natural language task creation, multi-dimensional product filtering, multi-channel instant notifications and Cron scheduling, with intelligent product matching capability to help users quickly locate desired items from massive Xianyu listings, and supports one-click Docker deployment.

summary.zh: 该项目是基于Java开发的斐讯R1智能音箱IoT改造方案，支持Docker容器化一键部署，可将闲置的斐讯R1音箱接入智能家居生态，实现设备自动化控制，低门槛盘活旧智能硬件，具备轻量化部署、适配消费级闲置IoT设备的特点。
summary.en: This project is an IoT modification solution for Phicomm R1 smart speaker developed with Java, supporting one-click Docker containerized deployment. It can connect idle Phicomm R1 speakers to the smart home ecosystem to achieve automated device control, revitalizing idle consumer IoT devices with low threshold, featuring lightweight deployment and compatibility with consumer-grade idle IoT hardware.

metadata.name: chinese-independent-developer
metadata.description: 👩🏿‍💻👨🏾‍💻👩🏼‍💻👨🏽‍💻👩🏻‍💻中国独立开发者项目列表 -- 分享大家都在做什么

summary.zh: 该仓库是中国独立开发者项目聚合列表，收录可直接使用的网站、App类产品，涵盖AI工具、效率应用、内容创作等场景，按开发中/已上线/停更分类标注，开放PR贡献，是开发者获取项目灵感、发现优质独立产品的社区资源。
summary.en: This repository is an aggregation list of projects by Chinese independent developers, collecting ready-to-use websites and apps covering scenarios like AI tools, productivity applications, and content creation. Projects are categorized by development/launched/discontinued status, with open PR contributions allowed. It serves as a community resource for developers to get project inspiration and discover high-quality independent products.

metadata.name: OpenList
metadata.description: A new AList Fork to Anti Trust Crisis

summary.zh: OpenList是应对开源信任危机的AList社区分叉项目，采用长期社区自治治理模式，支持阿里云盘、OneDrive、GoogleDrive等十余种本地/云存储的统一文件管理，基于Go开发，遵循AGPL-3.0开源协议，为个人及团队提供免费、透明的多云资源管理方案。

metadata.name: SaveAny-Bot
metadata.description: Save Any Telegram File to Anywhere 📂 (Alist, Disk, Webdav, S3, Rclone...) . Support restrict saving content and files beyond telegram.

summary.zh: SaveAny-Bot是一款Telegram自动化工具，核心解决Telegram文件跨端存储、受限内容保存需求，支持将Telegram及Telegraph内容自动保存至Alist、S3、WebDAV等十余种存储后端，具备批量下载、流式传输、监听自动保存、yt-dlp/Aria2集成、JS插件扩展等能力，适用于个人文件备份、资源归档等场景。
summary.en: SaveAny-Bot is a Telegram automation tool designed to solve cross-platform file storage and restricted content saving needs for Telegram users. It supports automatically saving Telegram and Telegraph content to over 10 storage backends including Alist, S3 and WebDAV, with features like batch download, streaming transfer, chat monitoring auto-save, yt-dlp/Aria2 integration and JS plugin extension, suitable for personal file backup and resource archiving scenarios.

metadata.name: ChinaTextbook
metadata.description: 所有小初高、大学PDF教材。

summary.zh: 本仓库开源整理国内小初高及大学阶段全学科PDF教材，旨在打破付费水印教材的信息壁垒，降低教育资源获取门槛，既支持欠发达地区义务教育普及，也为海外华人子女提供国内正统教育资源，助力自主性学习。
summary.en: This repository open-sources a complete collection of PDF textbooks covering all subjects for primary, junior high, senior high schools and universities in China. It aims to break the information barrier of paid watermarked educational resources, lower the threshold for accessing learning materials, support compulsory education popularization in underdeveloped regions, and provide overseas Chinese children with authentic domestic education resources for self-directed learning.

metadata.name: Deadpool
metadata.description: deadpool代理池工具，可从hunter、quake、fofa等网络空间测绘平台取高质量socks5代理，或本地导入socks5代理，轮询使用代理进行流量转发。

summary.zh: 本工具为Go开发的代理池工具，支持从hunter、quake、fofa等网络空间测绘平台采集高质量socks5代理，也可本地导入代理，具备代理健康检测、轮询转发能力，主要面向合法授权的网络安全测试场景，解决攻防过程中IP被封的代理需求，支持运行中切换代理、优雅关闭等特性。
summary.en: This is a Go-developed proxy pool tool that supports collecting high-quality socks5 proxies from cyberspace mapping platforms like Hunter, Quake, and FOFA, or importing local proxies. It features proxy health check, polling forwarding, and is designed for authorized cybersecurity testing scenarios to solve IP blocking issues in offensive and defensive operations, with capabilities like runtime proxy switching and graceful shutdown.

metadata.name: Bulk-Crap-Uninstaller
metadata.description: Remove large amounts of unwanted applications quickly.

summary.zh: Bulk Crap Uninstaller（BCU）是一款开源免费的Windows桌面批量卸载工具，基于.NET框架开发，可快速移除大量冗余应用、清理卸载残留、识别孤立程序，兼容Windows商店应用、Steam游戏及NSIS、InnoSetup等主流安装包格式，支持静默批量卸载，最小化用户操作即可完成系统清理，适用于个人及企业IT运维场景。
summary.en: Bulk Crap Uninstaller (BCU) is a free, open-source Windows desktop bulk uninstaller built on .NET framework, which enables quick removal of large amounts of unwanted applications with minimal user input. It can clean up uninstall leftovers, detect orphaned apps, and is compatible with Windows Store apps, Steam games, and mainstream installer formats including NSIS, InnoSetup and Msiexec. It supports silent uninstallation and batch operations, making it suitable for both personal system cleanup and enterprise IT maintenance scenarios.

metadata.name: PROXY-List
metadata.description: Get PROXY List  that gets updated everyday

summary.zh: 该仓库提供每日自动更新的免费公开代理列表，涵盖HTTP、SOCKS4、SOCKS5三类协议，共收录7000+代理资源，仅面向教育及合法开发场景，配套可用性检测工具，方便开发者快速获取可用代理，适用于爬虫、网络测试等用途。

metadata.name: DailyHotApi
metadata.description: 🔥 今日热榜 API，一个聚合热门数据的 API 接口，支持 RSS 模式 及 Vercel 部署 | 前端页面：https://github.com/imsyy/DailyHot

summary.summary: 今日热榜API是聚合全网主流平台热门榜单的轻量接口服务，支持JSON/RSS双模式返回，提供Vercel、Docker等多方式部署，覆盖B站、微博、知乎等十余个平台热榜数据，响应速度快、路由结构清晰，便于开发者快速集成热点数据能力。

metadata.name: lx-music-mobile
metadata.description: 一个基于 React native 开发的音乐软件

summary.zh: LX Music移动版是基于React Native与Redux开发的开源安卓音乐客户端，聚合多平台官方音乐源，支持自定义音源、私有数据同步服务部署，采用Apache 2.0补充协议开源，目前仅适配Android 5及以上系统。
summary.en: LX Music Mobile is an open-source Android music client built with React Native and Redux, integrating multiple official music platform sources. It supports custom audio sources and deployable private data sync services, licensed under Apache 2.0 with supplementary terms, currently compatible with Android 5 and above.

metadata.name: proxy-scraper
metadata.description: ⭐️ A proxy scraper made using Protractor | Proxy list Updates every three hour 🔥

summary.en: An automated proxy scraping tool built with Protractor, automatically updating over 1800 proxy resources every 3 hours via GitHub Actions. It supports HTTP/S, SOCKS4/5 proxy types, exports to 6 formats including TXT/JSON/CSV, supports MySQL storage, and comes with a proxy availability test script, suitable for web scraping, network testing and other scenarios.

metadata.name: breezy-weather
metadata.description: A feature-rich weather app with good visualizations and more than 50 sources.

summary.zh: Breezy Weather是一款免费开源的安卓天气应用，基于Kotlin与Jetpack Compose开发，采用Material 3 Expressive设计，支持50余种天气数据源，提供天气预报、空气质量、花粉指数、灾害预警等功能，可视化表现优秀，可通过F-Droid、GitHub Releases等渠道获取。
summary.en: Breezy Weather is a free and open-source Android weather app built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, featuring Material 3 Expressive design and polished visualizations. It integrates over 50 weather data sources to provide forecasts, air quality, pollen data, and alerts, and is available on F-Droid and GitHub Releases.

metadata.name: lxmusic-
metadata.description: lxmusic(洛雪音乐)全网最新最全音源

summary.zh: 该仓库为洛雪音乐（LX Music）及澜音音乐客户端的全网音源整合项目，提供多平台音源适配与持续更新，支持免费测试及多档位付费音源服务，用户可导入对应客户端使用，实现多平台音乐资源聚合。
summary.en: This repository is a full-network music source integration project for LX Music and Lanyin music clients, offering multi-platform source adaptation, continuous updates, free testing and tiered paid services. Users can import sources into corresponding clients to aggregate dispersed multi-platform music resources.

metadata.name: GitHubDesktop2Chinese
metadata.description: GithubDesktop语言本地化(汉化)工具 【GitHub桌面客户端中文汉化】

summary.zh: 这是GitHub Desktop客户端的中文汉化工具，基于C++开发，通过正则匹配替换本地化映射文件实现汉化，具备高版本兼容性、自动更新、选择性替换等特性，大幅降低汉化维护成本，方便国内开发者使用。
summary.en: This is a Chinese localization tool for GitHub Desktop client, developed in C++. It realizes localization by replacing the localization mapping file via regular expression matching, featuring high version compatibility, automatic update, selective replacement and other capabilities, greatly reducing localization maintenance cost for domestic developers.

metadata.name: Douyin_TikTok_Download_API
metadata.description: 🚀 Self-hosted TikTok & Douyin scraper and no-watermark video downloader — async REST API, MCP server, CLI and web console for posts, profiles, comments and playlists. Self-healing identity pool, PostgreSQL archive, one docker compose up. 抖音、TikTok 数据采集与无水印视频下载 API，自托管，支持 MCP 调用与 Docker 一键部署。

summary.zh: 自托管抖音、TikTok数据采集与无水印视频下载工具，提供REST API、MCP服务、CLI及Web控制台，支持帖子、作者、评论、搜索内容采集，具备自愈身份池，可对接PostgreSQL存储，支持Docker一键部署。
summary.en: A self-hosted solution for Douyin and TikTok data scraping and no-watermark video downloading, providing REST API, MCP server, CLI and web console. It supports collection of posts, authors, comments and search content, features a self-healing identity pool, integrates with PostgreSQL storage, and enables one-click deployment via Docker.
tags_zh: 短视频数据采集与无水印下载

metadata.name: HelloGitHub
metadata.description: :octocat: 分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级的开源项目。Share interesting, entry-level open source projects on GitHub.

summary.summary: HelloGitHub是面向开发者的开源项目推荐月刊，每月28日更新，收录有趣、入门级、实战类等优质开源项目与开源书籍，通过官网、公众号等多渠道分发，帮助开发者快速发现优质开源资源，降低开源探索门槛。

metadata.name: BPB-Worker-Panel
metadata.description: A GUI Panel providing Worker subscriptions for VLESS, Trojan and Warp configs alongside a private DoH server and chain proxies, offering full DNS, clean IP,  Fragment, Warp, Warp pro and routing settings for cross-platform clients using Amnezia, Wireguard, Sing-box, Clash/Mihomo and Xray cores.

summary.zh: BPB Panel是基于Cloudflare Workers部署的免费私有代理工具面板，提供VLESS、Trojan、Warp代理配置及私有DoH服务，支持链式代理、流量分片、自定义路由规则，适配Xray、Sing-box等多核心跨平台客户端，可解决网络封锁下的安全访问需求，部署操作简单。
summary.en: BPB Panel is a free private proxy tool panel deployed on Cloudflare Workers, offering VLESS, Trojan and Warp proxy configurations alongside a private DoH server. It supports chain proxy, traffic fragmentation, custom routing rules, and works with multi-core cross-platform clients like Xray and Sing-box, fulfilling secure access needs under network blocking with simple deployment.
tags_zh: Cloudflare Workers 多核心代理集成
网络封锁绕过 安全私有访问
tags_en: Cloudflare Workers Deployment, Multi-core Proxy Integration

metadata.name: notepad--
metadata.description: 一个支持windows/linux/mac的文本编辑器，目标是做中国人自己的编辑器，来自中国。

summary.zh: Notepad--是一款支持Windows、Linux、macOS的轻量级国产文本编辑器，核心目标是实现文本编辑类软件的国产可替代，重点适配国产信创Uos等操作系统，具备跨平台、轻量化特性，为用户提供合规的文本编辑工具选择。

metadata.name: HotPEToolBox
metadata.description: 一个纯净、强大、优雅的WinPE

summary.zh: 这是HotPE官方构建工具仓库，可基于Win10/11原版镜像生成纯净Win11PE，支持网络、远程、BitLocker解锁、U盘启动等丰富功能，兼容Edgeless插件与HotPE模块，MIT开源，适用于系统维护、故障排查等场景。
summary.en: This is the official build tool repository of HotPE, which generates a clean Win11PE based on original Win10/11 system images. It supports rich functions such as network connectivity, remote access, BitLocker decryption, USB boot, etc., is compatible with Edgeless plugins and HotPE modules, open-sourced under MIT license, and suitable for system maintenance and troubleshooting scenarios.

metadata.name: yt-dlp
metadata.description: A feature-rich command-line audio/video downloader

summary.summary: yt-dlp是youtube-dl的活跃维护分支，是一款功能全面的命令行音视频下载工具，支持上千家站点音视频资源获取，提供格式智能筛选、元数据编辑、SponsorBlock去广告、插件扩展等特性，可嵌入第三方项目，适用于媒体资源采集、离线观看等场景。

metadata.name: GoGoGo
metadata.description: 一个基于 Android 调试 API + 百度地图实现的虚拟定位工具，并且同时实现了一个可以自由移动的摇杆

summary.:: 影梭是基于Android调试API与百度地图SDK开发的安卓8.0+无Root虚拟定位工具，支持位置修改、摇杆模拟移动、坐标搜索与历史记录功能，可用于Android定位开发技术学习，明确禁止用于游戏及校园运动作弊。
summary.en: Yingsuo (GoGoGo) is a no-root virtual location tool for Android 8.0+, built on Android Debug API and Baidu Map SDK. It supports location spoofing, joystick-controlled movement simulation, location search and history records, serving as a learning resource for Android location development, and is prohibited for cheating use.

metadata.name: iptv-api
metadata.description: ⚡️ IPTV直播源自动更新工具：自动采集、校验、测速并生成可播放结果，支持 M3U/TXT/API 输出、自定义频道、IPv4/IPv6、Docker、GitHub Actions、CLI 与 GUI 多端部署

summary.zh: ⚡️ IPTV直播源自动更新工具，全流程自动化完成直播源采集、多源聚合、可用性校验、测速筛选，支持生成M3U/TXT/API格式播放列表，可自定义频道规则，支持CLI、GUI、Docker等多端部署，解决直播源手动维护繁琐、易失效的痛点。
summary.en: ⚡️ Automated IPTV live source update tool that completes the full process of live source collection, multi-source aggregation, availability verification and speed testing filtering, generates playable playlists in M3U/TXT/API formats, supports custom channel rules, and offers multi-deployment options including CLI, GUI and Docker, solving the pain points of tedious manual live source maintenance and easy invalidation.

metadata.name: NetMount
metadata.description: 统一管理和挂载云存储设施/Unified management and mounting of cloud storage facilities

summary.summary: NetMount是开源跨平台云存储统一管理工具，基于Rust+Tauri+React开发，集成Rclone与OpenList核心能力，支持多类云存储服务的挂载、统一管控，简化个人及团队多云资源访问流程，降低跨存储服务切换成本。

metadata.name: taosync
metadata.description: TaoSync是一个适用于OpenList v3+的自动化同步工具/Sync for OpenList/AList

summary.zh: TaoSync是开源跨平台自动化文件同步工具，兼容OpenList/AList v3+生态且内置存储引擎无需额外部署，支持全量/增量同步、定时任务，可用于多存储端文件备份、跨云盘同步、定时资源下载等场景，支持多架构与Docker部署。
summary.en: TaoSync is an open-source cross-platform automated file synchronization tool compatible with OpenList/AList v3+ ecosystem, featuring a built-in storage engine that eliminates the need for additional OpenList deployment. It supports full/incremental sync and scheduled tasks, applicable to multi-storage file backup, cross-cloud drive sync, and scheduled resource download, and supports multi-architecture and Docker deployment.

metadata.name: tvbox
metadata.description: OK影视、tvbox配置文件，如果喜欢，请Fork自用。使用前请仔细阅读仓库说明，一旦使用将被视为你已了解。

summary.zh: 本仓库是TVBox、猫影视等影音工具的聚合配置库，整合多路开发者分享的点播源、直播线路及适配jar包，提供极简、全量等多版本场景化配置，适配电视、移动端等多终端，配套相关应用推荐与网盘授权指南，仅供个人学习测试使用。
summary.en: This repository serves as an aggregated configuration library for TVBox, CatVod and other audio-visual tools, integrating VOD sources, live broadcast channels and compatible jar packages shared by multiple developers. It provides multi-version scenario-based configurations such as minimalist and full-featured ones, supports TV, mobile and other terminals, and comes with related app recommendations and cloud drive authorization guides, for personal learning and testing only.

metadata.name: NoMoreWalls
metadata.description: 自动抓取合并互联网上的公开节点。

summary.zh: NoMoreWalls 是自动抓取合并互联网公开代理节点的工具，可生成适配 Clash Meta 等客户端的订阅配置与分流规则，提供多CDN镜像保障访问稳定性，采用反996许可证，附带明确的安全提示与合规要求。
summary.en: NoMoreWalls is a tool that automatically fetches and merges public proxy nodes from the internet, generates subscription configurations and routing rules for clients like Clash Meta, provides multi-CDN mirrors for access stability, adopts the Anti-996 License, and includes clear security tips and compliance requirements.

metadata.name: Cloudflare-vless-trojan
metadata.description: CF-workers/pages代理脚本：支持Vless-ws(tls)、Trojan-ws(tls)；Socks5/http本地代理脚本：可选ECH-TLS、普通TLS、无TLS三种代理模式

summary.value: 这是部署于Cloudflare Workers/Pages的边缘代理工具，支持VLESS、Trojan的ws+tls代理协议，内置CF官方优选IP无需频繁更新，无需依赖第三方订阅，可生成多格式客户端订阅链接，同时提供支持ECH-TLS等多模式的本地代理脚本，降低小白部署使用门槛。

metadata.name: cf-proxy-ex
metadata.description: Cloudflare超级代理，无服务器代理，Duckduckgo代理（可用AI聊天，包含GPT4o/Claude3），Github加速，支持解锁Libgen，在线代理。现已支持多平台部署。Cloudflare super proxy, setting up a free serverless proxy by using Cloudflare worker, support Duckduckgo / Libgen. Now you can deploy this project on different platforms.

summary.zh: 基于Cloudflare Worker的无服务器在线代理工具，支持Cloudflare、Deno等多平台部署，无需服务器运维成本，可实现Github加速、Libgen学术资源解锁、Duckduckgo AI聊天代理（支持GPT4o/Claude3），内置密码安全校验与Cookie域隔离机制，用于安全访问受限网络资源。
summary.en: A serverless online proxy tool built on Cloudflare Worker, supporting deployment on multiple platforms including Cloudflare and Deno without server operation and maintenance costs. It enables GitHub acceleration, Libgen academic resource access, and proxying for DuckDuckGo AI chat (supporting GPT-4o and Claude 3). With built-in password verification and Cookie domain isolation to prevent credential leakage, it is designed for accessing restricted network resources safely.

metadata.name: Nagram
metadata.description: The third-party Telegram android app.

summary.zh: Nagram是基于NekoX二次开发的第三方Telegram安卓客户端，内置多协议代理、自定义表情包、全文翻译等增强功能，支持多账号登录、消息批量操作及高度自定义配置，解决原版功能受限、代理配置繁琐的痛点，适配各类使用场景，为安卓用户提供更灵活、隐私性更强的Telegram使用体验。
summary.en: Nagram is a third-party Telegram Android client forked from NekoX, featuring built-in multi-protocol proxy support, custom emoji packs, full-text translation, and enhanced message operations. It supports multi-account login and highly customizable settings, solving pain points of limited official features and complicated proxy setup, suitable for diverse scenarios, offering Android users a more flexible, privacy-focused Telegram experience.

metadata.name: ecs
metadata.description: VPS 融合怪服务器测评脚本 —— 更推荐使用无环境依赖的 Go 版本：https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs VPS Fusion Monster Server Test Script — we now recommend the Go version (zero external dependencies): https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs

summary.zh: 这是VPS服务器综合测评Shell脚本（融合怪测评脚本），支持多系统多架构，提供无交互参数执行模式，可完成IP质量检测、回程路由、网络基准测试等任务，现已重构为无环境依赖的Go版本，适配非root等极端测试场景。
summary.en: This is a comprehensive VPS server testing shell script (Fusion Monster Test Script), supporting multiple systems and architectures. It provides a non-interactive parameter execution mode, capable of IP quality detection, return route testing, network benchmark testing and other tasks. It has been refactored into a Go version with zero external dependencies, suitable for extreme test scenarios like non-root execution.

metadata.name: awesome-cloudflare
metadata.description: ⛅️ 精选的 Cloudflare 工具、开源项目、指南、博客和其他资源列表。/ ⛅️ A curated list of Cloudflare tools, open source projects, guides, blogs and other resources.

summary.zh: 本仓库是专为独立开发者整理的 Cloudflare 生态开源资源精选列表，收录图床、对象存储、短链、网站分析等多类轻量易部署的工具、开源项目与教程，帮助开发者提升开发效率、降低使用成本，持续更新中。
summary.en: This repository is a curated list of Cloudflare ecosystem open-source resources tailored for indie developers, collecting lightweight and easy-to-deploy tools, open-source projects and tutorials covering image hosting, object storage, short links, website analytics and more, helping developers boost development efficiency and reduce usage costs, with continuous updates.

metadata.name: Sandboxie
metadata.description: Sandboxie Plus & Classic

summary.zh: Sandboxie是开源的Windows系统级沙盒隔离工具，提供Plus与Classic双版本，可在隔离虚拟环境中运行或安装程序，不修改主机系统、注册表及磁盘数据，支持多沙盒并行运行，适用于不可信程序测试、安全上网、恶意软件防护等场景，Plus版搭载Qt现代化界面并支持快照管理等增强功能。
summary.en: Sandboxie is an open-source system-level sandbox isolation tool for Windows, available in Plus and Classic editions. It creates isolated virtual environments to run or install programs without modifying the host system, registry or disk data, supports parallel multi-sandbox operation, and is applicable to untrusted program testing, secure surfing and malware defense. The Plus edition features a modern Qt-based UI and enhanced functions like snapshot management.

metadata.name: proxypin
metadata.description: Open source free capture HTTP(S) traffic  software ProxyPin, supporting full platform systems

summary.zh: ProxyPin是开源免费的跨平台HTTP/HTTPS流量抓包工具，基于Flutter开发，支持Windows、Mac、Android、iOS、Linux全平台，支持Flutter应用流量抓取与扫码快速连代理，提供流量过滤、脚本处理、请求重写/拦截/解密、HAR格式导出等功能，适用于移动端与Web开发调试、网络问题排查场景。
summary.en: ProxyPin is an open-source, free cross-platform HTTP/HTTPS traffic capture tool built with Flutter, supporting Windows, Mac, Android, iOS and Linux. It supports Flutter app traffic capture and QR code quick proxy connection, and offers features like traffic filtering, script processing, request rewriting/blocking/decryption and HAR export, suitable for mobile and Web development debugging as well as network troubleshooting.

metadata.name: FreeNodes
metadata.description: v2ray、clash免费节点爬虫，自动更新

summary.:: AI驱动的v2ray/Clash免费节点自动爬虫项目，每日定时运行更新，聚合多源公开节点资源，提供标准订阅文件与镜像加速链接，仅供学习交流使用，简化代理节点获取流程。
summary.en: An AI-powered crawler for free V2Ray/Clash nodes that operates automatically on a daily basis. It aggregates node resources from multiple public sources, offers standard subscription files and mirrored acceleration links, for learning and communication use only, simplifying the process of obtaining proxy nodes.

metadata.name: GOODBYEADS
metadata.description: 适用于AdGuard、Quantumult X、SmartDNS的去广告规则，合并优质上游规则并去重整理排列。

summary.zh: GOODBYEADS是面向AdGuard、Quantumult X、SmartDNS等主流网络工具的强力去广告规则集合，合并多源优质上游规则并去重整理，提供多格式规则文件与国内加速订阅，支持DNS拦截、域名黑名单、白名单等多种规则类型，拥有超21万条拦截规则，定时更新保障全面去广告效果。
summary.en: GOODBYEADS is a powerful, regularly updated ad-blocking rule set designed for mainstream network tools including AdGuard, Quantumult X and SmartDNS. It merges and deduplicates high-quality upstream rules from multiple authoritative sources, offers multi-format rule files with domestic accelerated subscriptions, supports DNS blocking, domain blacklists and whitelists, with over 210,000 blocking rules to ensure comprehensive ad interception.

metadata.name: N3RD
metadata.description: CTV

summary.zh: N3RD是面向互联网电视（CTV）场景的开发项目，聚焦智能电视端应用开发与生态适配需求，为相关开发者提供开发工具与能力支撑，助力CTV生态应用高效落地。
summary.en: N3RD is a development project targeting Connected TV (CTV) scenarios, focusing on the needs of smart TV application development and ecosystem adaptation, providing development tools and capability support for relevant developers to facilitate efficient deployment of CTV ecosystem applications.

metadata.name: adblockfilters
metadata.description: 去广告合并规则，每8个小时更新一次。

summary.zh: 本仓库为自动合并更新的广告过滤规则库，每8小时同步上游规则源，经合并去重、多节点DNS验证剔除无效域名后生成多版本规则，适配AdGuard、AdGuard Home、DNSMasq等主流工具，提供国内加速链接与国内域名精简版，有效降低误拦截概率。
summary.en: This repository provides an automatically merged and updated ad-blocking filter list to eliminate the hassle of manual rule configuration on multiple devices, syncing upstream rule sources every 8 hours. After deduplication and invalid domain removal via multi-node DNS verification, it generates multi-version rules compatible with mainstream tools like AdGuard, AdGuard Home and DNSMasq, with domestic acceleration links and lite versions for Chinese domains to reduce false blocking.

metadata.name: TikTokDownloader
metadata.description: 抖音 / TikTok 平台作品下载/数据采集工具

summary.:: DouK-Downloader 是基于 Python 开发的抖音/TikTok 双平台作品下载与数据采集工具，支持最高画质视频/图集批量下载、账号作品/评论/直播数据采集，提供 WebUI 交互界面，支持多线程、断点续传、多格式数据持久化及 Docker 部署，适用于内容备份、平台数据分析等场景。
summary.en: DouK-Downloader is a Python-based dual-platform tool for downloading works and collecting data from Douyin and TikTok. It supports high-definition video/image batch download, account works/comment/live stream data collection, provides WebUI interface, and features multi-threading, breakpoint resumption, multi-format data persistence and Docker deployment, suitable for content backup and platform data analysis.
tags_zh: 短视频下载与数据采集

metadata.name: x-ui-yg
metadata.description: x-ui精简修改版脚本，支持Hysteria2、Xhttp传输协议、ENC加密、MLDSA65加密，集成argo固定临时双隧道（可共存）、Psiphon赛风VPN（30个国家）分流功能，支持部分节点聚合订阅、sing-box订阅、clash-meta订阅的配置输出

summary.:: x-ui精简修改版一键部署脚本，面板设置与原版保持一致，支持Hysteria2、Xhttp传输协议及ENC、MLDSA65加密，集成Argo固定临时双隧道、Psiphon赛风VPN分流能力，可本地化生成多协议聚合订阅及Clash-meta、Sing-box配置，适配多架构与Alpine系统，提供官方Docker版本。
summary.en: A streamlined modified one-click deployment script for the x-ui panel, with settings aligned to the original version. It supports transmission protocols including Hysteria2 and Xhttp, alongside ENC and MLDSA65 encryption. Featuring integrated Argo fixed and temporary dual tunnels and Psiphon VPN traffic splitting, it can locally generate multi-protocol aggregated subscriptions and configurations for Clash-meta and Sing-box. Compatible with multiple architectures and Alpine system, with an official Docker version available.

metadata.name: mediago
metadata.description: Cross-platform video downloader — sniff and grab m3u8/HLS streams, Bilibili, YouTube and more. Desktop + Docker + 🦞.

summary.summary: MediaGo 是跨平台视频下载工具，内置嗅探能力可直接抓取 m3u8/HLS 流，支持 Bilibili、YouTube 等 1000+ 视频站点。提供桌面端、Docker 部署、浏览器插件、AI 助手集成及开放 HTTP API，无需抓包或配置扩展即可快速下载，还支持内置格式转换。

metadata.name: biliup
metadata.description: 自动直播录制、投稿、twitch、ytb频道搬运工具。命令行投稿(B站)和视频下载工具，提供多种登录方式，支持多p。边录边传0落盘

summary.zh: 开源跨平台直播录制与自动化投稿工具，基于Rust开发，支持19个主流直播平台录制及弹幕抓取，具备边录边传零落盘、多账号管理、WebUI可视化监控能力，可24小时无人值守运行，支持命令行封装与AI Agent集成，适配直播内容搬运、UP主自动投稿等场景。
summary.en: An open-source cross-platform live recording and automated upload tool built with Rust. It supports recording and danmaku capture for 19 mainstream live platforms, features zero-disk recording and uploading, multi-account management, WebUI visual monitoring, and 24/7 unattended operation. It also supports CLI encapsulation and AI Agent integration, suitable for live content reposting and creator auto-upload scenarios.

metadata.name: anti-AD
metadata.description: 致力于成为中文区命中率最高的广告过滤列表，实现精确的广告屏蔽和隐私保护。anti-AD 现已支持 AdGuardHome，dnsmasq，Surge，Pi-Hole，Clash, mihomo，smartdns，sing-box 等网络组件。完全兼容常见的广告过滤工具所支持的各种广告过滤列表格式

summary.zh: anti-AD是面向中文区的高命中率广告过滤与隐私保护工具，基于DNS解析层实现广告屏蔽与隐私防护，支持AdGuardHome、dnsmasq、Surge、Pi-Hole等十余种主流网络组件，兼容各类广告过滤列表格式，可屏蔽广告域名、设备内置广告及隐私收集站点，通过合并去重上游规则、优化匹配逻辑提升拦截精准度。
summary.en: anti-AD is a high-accuracy ad blocking and privacy protection tool tailored for Chinese users, working at the DNS resolution layer. It supports over 10 mainstream network components including AdGuardHome, dnsmasq, Surge and Pi-Hole, is compatible with common ad filter list formats, and can block ad domains, built-in device ads and privacy-tracking sites. It improves blocking accuracy by merging and deduplicating upstream rules and optimizing matching logic.

metadata.description: 🔥 1Panel is a modern, open-source Linux server management panel and a lightweight AI management platform.

summary.summary: 1Panel是开源Linux服务器管理面板与轻量AI管理平台，通过可视化Web界面提供主机监控、文件/数据库/容器管理、一键网站部署、AI网关与Agent统一托管等能力，大幅降低服务器运维与AI应用落地门槛，服务全球超250万自托管用户。

summary.zh: downkyi 是哔哩哔哩视频下载桌面工具，支持下载高清视频、弹幕字幕及付费会员内容，因逆向分析B站非公开接口、绕过反爬风控与鉴权机制抓取受保护内容，收到B站委托律所律师函，目前已停止维护并永久关停。
summary.en: downkyi is a Bilibili video downloading desktop application that supports downloading high-definition videos, bullet comments, subtitles and paid member-exclusive content. It received a lawyer's letter from Bilibili's entrusted law firm for reverse-engineering Bilibili's non-public interfaces, bypassing anti-crawler risk control and signature authentication mechanisms to scrape protected content, and has now ceased maintenance and been permanently closed.

summary.en: SmartTube is a free, open-source media client designed for Android TV and TV boxes, serving as an alternative to the official YouTube app. It supports 8K/60fps/HDR playback, integrates SponsorBlock for ad skipping, runs without Google Services, and works with devices running Android 4.3 or higher, delivering an ad-free, TV-optimized viewing experience.

summary.zh: changedetection.io 是开源网站变更检测监控工具，可实时追踪网页内容变化，支持 Discord、邮件、Slack 等多渠道告警，集成大模型实现智能变更过滤与自然语言摘要，适用于价格监控、补货提醒、内容变更追踪、网站篡改监测等场景，提供自托管与 SaaS 双模式。
summary.en: changedetection.io is an open-source website change detection and monitoring tool that tracks webpage content updates in real time, supports multi-channel alerts via Discord, Email, Slack and more, integrates LLMs for intelligent change filtering and plain-language summaries, applicable to price tracking, restock alerts, content change monitoring and website defacement detection, with both self-hosted and SaaS options available.

metadata.name: rsspush
metadata.description: 监测RSS变动，并发送最新内容到微信、Webhook 和 Telegram, Discord, Slack, Amazon SNS, Gotify 等数十个消息通道。

summary.zh: RSSPush 是开源 RSS 变动监测工具，可自动追踪订阅源更新并推送至微信、Telegram、Discord 等数十个消息通道，支持 Docker 一键部署、内置 RSSHub 源库、关键词黑白名单过滤、内容自动翻译，满足个人与团队的多平台内容聚合通知需求。
summary.en: RSSPush is an open-source RSS change monitoring tool that automatically tracks subscribed feed updates and pushes them to dozens of messaging channels including WeChat, Telegram and Discord. It supports one-click Docker deployment, built-in RSSHub source library, keyword blacklist/whitelist filtering, and automatic content translation, meeting the multi-platform content aggregation notification needs of individuals and teams.

metadata.name: WebMonitor
metadata.description: 实时监控网页变化，并发送通知（Monitor web page changes in real time and send notifications）

summary.zh: WebMonitor是一款轻量化网页变更监控工具，可实时监测网页内容变化并推送多渠道通知，适用于舆情监控、竞品价格追踪、RSS更新提醒等场景；技术亮点包括支持PhantomJS抓取异步网页、XPath/CSS选择器与JsonPath多维度数据提取、可视化配置及Docker一键部署。
summary.en: WebMonitor is a lightweight web change monitoring tool that detects webpage content changes in real time and delivers multi-channel notifications. It applies to scenarios like public opinion monitoring, competitor price tracking, and RSS update alerts. Key technical highlights include PhantomJS-based asynchronous webpage crawling, multi-dimensional data extraction via XPath/CSS selectors and JsonPath, visual configuration, and one-click Docker deployment.

summary.en: FileCentipede is an all-in-one cross-platform internet file upload/download manager supporting over 10 protocols including HTTP(S), FTP, SSH, magnet links, BitTorrent and m3u8. It integrates WebDAV, FTP, SSH clients and browser extensions to download encrypted online videos, and offers auxiliary tools like HTTP requester, file merger and encoders, featuring high speed, strong customizability and user-friendly design.

summary.en: v2rayN is an open-source cross-platform GUI proxy client that supports mainstream proxy cores like Xray and sing-box. It is compatible with Windows, Linux and macOS, as well as multiple CPU architectures, and provides GPG signature verification to ensure installer security, making it a popular practical tool for network proxy scenarios.

summary.en: This repository provides an out-of-the-box one-click deployment solution for V2Ray WebSocket proxy on the Heroku platform, suitable for lightweight proxy scenarios for individual users to access restricted content. It automatically syncs to the latest V2Ray version, supports Cloudflare integration to optimize access speed, and avoids account bans caused by excessive resource usage when used properly, with an optional VLESS protocol branch available.
